context: Independently phrased occurrence-qualified source references, not adopted controls. These fragments inherit context from their consuming articles; eligibility, merge-protection, preview and billing statements are source-scoped, not current platform truth. Exact Liquid predicates, variable/include identities, template expressions and links are inert authoring evidence; no rendering, setup, scan, upload, billing/license agreement or native enforcement occurred. Referencing a linked artifact does not certify its reading or rights. Source strengths describe upstream language and examples, not project authorization. Analyze@v4 is a tag, not deployment provenance; numerical SARIF maxima and truncation values are separate contracts. Existing targeted claims need explicit reconciliation, not inherited coverage.
